effects.printed_clause: When a card is activated as Chain Link 2 or higher, or when a Scarstech card or effect is activated (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: An EVENT_CHAINING hand Quick Effect accepts ev>=2 or a reason-effect handler carrying SET_SCARSTECH, then Special Summons the handler.

official_references.matched_structure: Responds to a card/effect activated at Chain Link 2 or higher.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 Scarstech Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: Cloned delayed summon triggers share id+100 and search a Scarstech Spell/Trap.

effects.printed_clause: When a card or effect is activated as Chain Link 2 or higher (Quick Effect): Inflict damage equal to the Chain Link number of this effect times 200.
effects.lua_implementation: An EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect requires ev>=2, stores ev+1 as this responding effect's Chain Link number, and damages the opponent by stored value*200.

official_references.matched_structure: Inflicts damage multiplied by this card's Chain Link number.
Inflicts damage based on the Chain Link number of the responding effect.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Scarstech Dragon once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The three effects use id, id+100, and id+200 hard once-per-turn keys.

coverage_override.reason: The four records separately cover the hand Quick Effect (including its two alternative activation conditions), the shared Normal/Special Summon search, the Chain-Link-scaled damage effect, and the distinct once-per-turn limits. The heuristic double-counts the Special Summon performed by the first effect.
